# Native seat-guard test fixtures

These two files are exact snapshots of the commissioned Central guard v2 source. They are mode 0644 data fixtures. The tests copy them into controlled test Worlds and set mode 0755 there. They are not protected Control installation, native accepted history, seat adoption or human Recognition.

The O:I primitive-integrity commission authorises mechanical repair. The Agent executor remains separately attributable. Both precede actual hosted qualification. The original owner paths are `Control/user/seat-guard/hooks/pre-commit` and `Control/user/seat-guard/hooks/pre-push`. No personal register, claim, credential or World source is copied.

Linux must run all three real definitions, including the full production O:I landing tier at an explicit Root-admitted tip and a normal push to a controlled local bare Main. These copies do not become a second receipt authority, and no prior receipt is transported into the producer clone.
